references.text: The original instruction from God to Moses on how the lampstand should be made, with three almond-shaped cups, buds, and flowers on each arm. Exodus 37:19 describes the execution of this instruction.
The entire passage containing God's detailed instructions for the design of the lampstand, which Bezalel followed when he made it in chapter 37.
The complete description of the making of the lampstand, where verse 19 is part of this continuous account.
Describes the appearance of the lampstand with floral work and confirms that it was made according to the pattern shown by the Lord to Moses.
The lampstands in Solomon's temple, which were based on the original design from the tabernacle.
Zechariah's vision of a golden lampstand, linking back to the original lampstand in the tabernacle.
Mentions the lampstand as part of the holy place in the tabernacle and highlights its significance in Old Testament worship.
John's vision of seven golden lampstands, symbolically linking back to the lampstand in the tabernacle.
Complementary detailed description that completes the picture of the lampstand's structure and decoration.
Complementary description of the floral motif on the main stem that complements the arms.
Structural prerequisite defining the number and placement of the decorated arms.
The chronological conclusion of the process describing the completion of the same object.
